svg.title: Wild Men / Savage Men: elevation · close-up in context
svg.desc: Elevation of a carved hairy man with a leafy wreath and a long forked beard, a studded club raised in one hand and a heraldic shield on the other arm, standing on a stepped corbel, with light shading on the side away from the light, and a shaded round close-up of his head and beard. Source: Original drawing by Project Exodus from the standard geometric construction of this form; no external drawing reproduced.

g.text: WHOLE FIGURE ON ITS CORBEL · ELEVATION
CLOSE-UP · ×4 · FIGURE ABOUT 1.7 m TALL · LIGHT FROM THE UPPER LEFT

construction of this form; no external drawing reproduced.
